Logbook

12,772 lines, 2026-05-31 – 2026-06-30 (Europe/Oslo).

  • The last day, 2026-06-30: the Day as a timeline.
  • The last fortnight, one row per day.
  • Trips of 2026: runs of nights away.
  • Journeys: the trips one at a time, named, with their days, stays, photos and promises.
  • People: the people the record names, by days together; the review of who it has not placed.
  • The Manifest: the orgs you named, under what you decided about them; the review of the ones the sources saw.
  • Ideas: the ideas you named, by stage, each with its timeline; the review of the ones the sources saw.
  • Promises: what was promised in the messages, to whom and by whom, open first.
  • Goals: the goals you wrote, by horizon, and the chapter today is in.
  • Agents: the sessions with an agent, day by day.
  • Search: the record's words, as logbook search finds them.
  • Places: the named places of the record.
  • Assets: the assets tracked and the last fix of each.
  • Gaps: where each source went quiet.
  • The world: the places of the record on a map of the world.
